subject: RE: Ambu + Encord
text:
Hi Team,

First of all, thank you for implementing the automatic pause/freeze functionality. We have tested it, and it seems to work perfectly. This completes our request for the Annotator #2 workflow for keyframes annotated by Annotator #1 which is a very important feature for us.

We are now focusing on the review phase and have a few questions.

We understand that the IoU-Based Comparison functionality is available. However, we are currently unable to determine when the IoU comparison is being applied during the Consensus Review workflow. We cannot see the resulting IoU score, threshold, or comparison outcome, making it difficult to understand why annotations are approved or flagged for review. (See attached screenshot)

As previously discussed, we would like the following review-phase enhancements:

1. Automatically approve matching annotations

  *   Annotations should be automatically approved when both annotators have selected the same class and the annotation overlap exceeds the configured IoU threshold.
  *   In these cases, no disagreement should be created, as there is no meaningful difference requiring manual review.

2. Show only disagreements in Review list (Annotator Labels list or issues list)
The Issues panel should only display cases where an actual disagreement exists, such as:

  *   Different class labels
  *   Missing annotations from one annotator
  *   Annotation overlap below the configured IoU threshold
  *   Different attribute values

Currently, the review list is not particularly useful because annotations are shown even when no disagreement exists. Ideally, annotator labels should only appear in the review queue when a disagreement has been identified

Could you provide an update on the feasibility and timeline for these enhancements?

If some of these capabilities are already available, it may be helpful to schedule a demo of the Consensus Review workflow. Based on our current testing, it is not clear when the IoU comparison is being a

subject: Re: CVPR - encord demo
text:
Hi there
I would be appreciate if you can provide me with a rough estimate based on
a 40k image-based lane segmentation annotation service in regards to the
following aspects:
1. what would be the cohort size assigned to this task and what would be
the reviewer/annotator ratio?
2. what would be typical calibration time needed and lead time for the
production batch?
3. will the teammates only allow to use Encord owned devices to
annotate/review?
4. How is the raw data stored?
5. What would be the pricing mode for this example task and can you give me
a price per each polygon or per man hour?
6. Is there min man hour requirement for all tasks?
7. What if we have a sparse task assignment pattern? Say 1 month gap
between tasks?
8. Are you open to a POC?
8. To platform itself, may I also ask for a quote?
Sorry for asking a lot of questions ( I do have a deadline on my side LOL)
and looking forward for your response
